propositions: Pandoc subprocess can hang indefinitely on pathological input (observed 13.5 min at 95.8% CPU) because pypandoc sets no timeout and subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child, leaving spinning grandchildren orphaned.

The renderer must replace subprocess.run(timeout=) with a custom subprocess.Popen(start_new_session=True) + caller-side communicate(input=markdown, timeout=dc_pandoc_timeout_s) + rebar._proc.reap_process_group to kill entire process groups on timeout.
Configuration key reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s (default 10s) must be readable from config file, environment, and documented across the standard four-file reconciler config surface.

The pypandoc-binary wheel (version 1.15, pandoc 3.6.1) must be pinned to exactly one version in pyproject.toml and verified in CI; a new repo-root NOTICE file must record pandoc's GPL license and upstream provenance.
Per-unit fallback semantics are unchanged: on timeout or non-zero exit, an affected unit degrades to its original Markdown verbatim without raising or affecting other units.
Rendered output across the committed 178-body corpus must remain byte-identical to the pre-hardening renderer, proving this change addresses robustness only and does not alter rendering behavior.
